newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian insurer Fondiaria buys Milano Assicurazioni stake.
newsitem.headline: Italian insurer Fondiaria buys Milano Assicurazioni stake.

text.p: Italian insurance company Fondiaria Assicurazioni is to pay 96.2 billion lire ($63 million) for a stake in Milano Assicurazione, Fondiaria said on Monday.
Fondiaria would buy 13 million ordinary shares, equivalent to 8.99 percent of Milano's ordinary share capital, and 4.017 million savings shares, equivalent to 13.07 percent of savings share capital.
Fondiaria would pay 6,588.9 lire per share for the ordinary stock and 2,625 lire for the ordinary stock, Fondiaria said.
Fondiaria will pay for the Milano shares in three instalments. Fifty percent will be paid for by year-end, a further 25 percent by the end of 1997 and the final 25 percent by the end of 1998.

Fondiaria said it would raise 63.35 billion lire from the sale of minority shareholdings in banks, including a 2.38 percent stake in Cassa di Risparmio di Firenze and 0.2 percent of Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino.
Meanwhile, Milano Assicurazioni is to sell its own two percent shareholding in Cassa di Risparmio di Firenze to Gruppo Bancario San Paolo.
The bank share transfers will be completed by the end of the year.
